samples.question: This picture is a 6 by 6 block of square rooms. Walls are solid ink, and you may walk between two rooms only through a doorway gap in the wall between them. Two rooms hold a black dot, and four other rooms have a coloured floor: orange, green, blue and pink. Exactly one of those four coloured rooms lies on every walking route between the two black dots; each of the other three can be left out by some route. Which coloured room is it? Answer with exactly one of: orange, green, blue, pink.
